summary: sweep-2's expansion of sanitizeHandle to strip ALL Cf runes now unconditionally removes U+200D ZERO WIDTH JOINER, which is REQUIRED to join emoji ZWJ sequences. Legitimate emoji handles (family/profession/couple sequences) are silently corrupted into their separate component emoji. This is a behavioral regression: the pre-sweep-2 IsControl-only strip (Cc only) left ZWJ intact, so these handles rendered correctly before.
scenario: A player sets handle "👨\u200D👩\u200D👧" (family emoji). sanitizeHandle drops both ZWJs, yielding "👨👩👧" — three unrelated emoji instead of one glyph. Same for 👨‍💻 -> 👨💻. Compounding: the 24-rune cap counts post-strip runes, so a long emoji handle can also be truncated mid-grapheme (dangling base char / variation selector) at the boundary. Security value of stripping the OTHER Cf runes (U+202E bidi override, U+200B/E/F, U+FEFF, U+2066-2069) is real and should be kept; only the ZWJ case is collateral damage.
suggested_fix: Preserve U+200D specifically while still dropping the dangerous Cf runes: `if r != '\u200D' && unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, r) { continue }`. (Optional hardening: also require ZWJ to sit BETWEEN two non-space runes so it can't be used as a leading/standalone injection char.) Leaves the bidi/zero-width strip intact but stops mangling legitimate emoji handles.
